name: Milkweed Tussock Moth
desc: Milkweed Tussock Moth (Euchaetes egle): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 38 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euchaetes egle, the milkweed tiger moth or milkweed tussock moth, is a moth in the family Erebidae and the tribe Arctiini, the tiger moths. The species was first described by Dru Drury in 1773.
